This is a direct-dependency candidate pin, not a fully resolved Kaggle environment lock. Python, PyTorch, NumPy, and transitive compatibility remain environment-supplied and must pass the notebook's version/import/pip-check gates.
PyTorch is supplied by the Kaggle runtime and is not installed or pinned by this notebook. The notebook must report its exact runtime version before any opt-in dependency install.
Accelerate is omitted because the candidate load path places the full, non-quantized model on one selected GPU and does not use device_map sharding. No offload is planned.
